metrics.tour_path_read: TOUR-PATH READ (worker, 27 Nov 2026, frontier F03): the site records each tour-path step as a GET of a beacon file /t/<event>.txt?s=<arrival tag> (app.js, assessment.js, paying-nav.js on main). Read them with the Netlify observability tool: get-topk, query_name urls_with_query, one URL filter per event (filters on the same field are ORed), e.g. https://evanstonseniorcareguide.com/t/checklist-click.txt, /t/assessment-started.txt, /t/assessment-completed.txt, /t/direct-inquiry-form-view.txt, /t/plan-visit-form-view.txt, /t/inquiry-submitted.txt, /t/landed.txt, /t/viewed-tour-questions.txt. The key's ?s= value is the arrival channel. An event absent from the result had 0 requests in the window: record 0, not null. Map: checklist_opens = checklist-click beacons (plus browser fetches of the PDF from an outside link such as fbclid, named in the note); assessment_starts = assessment-started; tour_form_views = direct-inquiry-form-view + plan-visit-form-view; tour_requests = inquiry-submitted (Gmail stays the check). Netlify keeps 24 hours, so a window older than that stays null.
